text:
alex: FYI customer 'PromoPulse' reporting a wave of 429s on their dedicated pool during a marketing blast at ~11:05 PST. Token/sec SLO breached, burst credits went to 0, clients getting 'admission:preempted'. Can we triage? :grimacing:

maria: Thanks — which dedicated pool ID and region? Any short repro steps or load pattern?

alex: pool_id=ded-nyc-7, region=us-east1. Spike looks like a ~6k tps ramp over 30s then sustained for ~2m. Attached curl from the client reproduces 429s quickly:
```bash
for i in {1..100}; do curl -s -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"x"}'; done
```
Response snippet: 429 + header `x-rw-admission: preempted`

jeff: Oncall here. Checking autoscale + admission logs now. Preliminary: prewarm webhook didn't spawn additional slots for ded-nyc-7 — autoscaler metrics show backlog grew until admission started rejecting.

sre-bot: deploy:admission-heuristic v2.1 was rolled out at 10:50 by tara to hosted and dedicated (tag mismatch warning).

tara: I pushed a change to the admission penalty curve earlier today to reduce tail latency for hosted customers. I scoped it to hosted but the env selector was wrong — looks like it also applied to dedicated pools. Reverting in progress.

maria: Also seeing noisy-slot signature on ded-nyc-7: single instance GPU utilization hitting 98% while others at ~30%. Token-bucket drained on that slot; KV cache thrash spikes at the same time. Snippet from metrics query:
```text
metric: gpu.utilization{pool=ded-nyc-7,slot=3} = 0.98
metric: admission.token_bucket{pool=ded-nyc-7} -> refill=0.0 for 90s
```

jeff: Likely two issues compounded: (1) admission heuristic made preemption too aggressive for dedicated pools, (2) noisy tenant saturated a single slot and cache eviction increased per-token cost causing token burn. Short-term mitigation: 1) increase pool reserve for PromoPulse to 2x for next 10m, 2) bump min_replicas for ded-nyc-7 from 3 -> 6, 3) pin PromoPulse to a carveout slice while we stabilize. I'll send commands to ops.

alex: Customer is also upset about billing — they were charged burst credits despite being on a dedicated contract. Need to separate billing vs. technical cause for them.

support-bot: Created billing ticket #BILL-9821 for PromoPulse, linking to this thread and flagging potential misclassification of burst usage for dedicated accounts.

maria: Repro in staging: use the same ramp but target a single slot to mimic noisy neighbor. Quick load generator we ran:
```bash
wrk -t4 -c100 -d60s --script=gen.lua https://staging-api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Steps: (A) ramp to 5k tps in 30s, (B) check admission logs: `kubectl logs -l app=admission-controller -n inference --since=2m | tail -n 200`
Expected: admission should throttle early but not preempt dedicated carveouts; current behavior preempts and drains tokens.

tara: After revert I'm pushing a targeted fix to the admission selector so dedicated pools ignore the hosted-only penalty curve. Will add an integration check to the deploy pipeline to verify `pool_type` gating.

jeff: Ops commands to run now (will execute and report back):
1) `rwctl pool update ded-nyc-7 --min-replicas 6 --reserve 2x`
2) `rwctl carveout create --pool ded-nyc-7 --account PromoPulse --duration 20m`
3) `kubectl rollout restart deploy/admission-controller -n inference`

alex: Executed 1+2, customer sees immediate drop in 429s as new replicas come up. They're still anxious about the credit/billing side.

maria: For RCA notes: root cause = bad env selector in admission heuristic rollout + amplified by a noisy tenant slot (GPU saturation + cache eviction). Mitigations: revert rollout, carveout PromoPulse, add pool_type gating, add pre-deploy integration test, add per-pool noisy-tenant detection and automated slot rebalancing.

sre-bot: incident: created INC-2026-1873 (Priority P2) for follow-up.

alex: I'll update the customer and attach INC-2026-1873 + BILL-9821. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

tara: Adding a post-deploy smoke check and a unit test for admission selector. I'll follow up with a changelog and link to the PR.

jeff: Filing a short playbook entry for 'promo blast prewarm' with steps to pre-reserve capacity and run a warmup trace.

maria: Marking this thread resolved for support triage; leaving RCA work items open with SRE/ENG.

alex: Closing loop with customer in email, will share status once billing ticket updates.
